close.title: Deactivate or delete account
close.deactivateHint: Your account disappears for others: the profile is hidden and you leave everyone's friend list. Your messages, servers and friendships are kept. To come back, just sign in again with your email and password.
close.deleteHint: The account stays deactivated for 30 days and then is deleted for good: profile, pictures, friendships and invites. During that time, signing in again lets you cancel. If you own a server, hand it over first. Your messages stay with the author "Deleted user", unless you ask to delete them too.
close.deactivateModal: You're signed out on every device. To reactivate, just sign in again with your email and password.
close.owner: You still own these servers. Hand them over to someone (Server settings › Members) or delete the server, then come back here.
close.confirmPassword: Confirm your password. Then we'll send a 6-digit code to your email.
close.typeCode: Type the code that arrived in your email.
close.deleteMessagesHint: In channels, conversations and groups, along with the files. Unchecked, they stay with the author "Deleted user".
close.grace: The account is deactivated now and deleted in 30 days. Until then, signing in again lets you cancel.
